mapper.select: INSERT INTO evaluation_dataset(name, description, evaluation_user_id, created_by) VALUES (#{request.name}, #{request.description}, #{request.evaluationUserId}, #{creator}) RETURNING id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO evaluation_case(dataset_id, case_index, case_snapshot) VALUES (#{datasetId}, #{index}, CAST(#{snapshot} AS jsonb))
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, description, evaluation_user_id, created_at, (SELECT count(*) FROM evaluation_case c WHERE c.dataset_id = d.id) AS case_count FROM evaluation_dataset d WHERE NOT deleted ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, name, description, evaluation_user_id, created_at FROM evaluation_dataset WHERE id = #{id} AND NOT deleted
SELECT id, case_index, case_snapshot::text AS snapshot FROM evaluation_case WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} ORDER BY case_index
SELECT id FROM evaluation_dataset ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
SELECT count(*) FROM evaluation_run WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
INSERT INTO evaluation_run(dataset_id, name, mode, config_snapshot) VALUES (#{datasetId}, #{name}, #{mode}, CAST(#{snapshot} AS jsonb)) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE evaluation_run SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = 'EVAL_LEASE_EXPIRED', finished_at = clock_timestamp(), updated_at = clock_timestamp(), lease_owner = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_expires_at < clock_timestamp()
mapper.select: UPDATE evaluation_run SET status = 'RUNNING', lease_owner = #{owner}, lease_expires_at = clock_timestamp() + (#{leaseMs} * interval '1 millisecond'), started_at = clock_timestamp(), updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = ( SELECT id FROM evaluation_run WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1 ) RETURNING id, dataset_id, mode, config_snapshot::text AS snapshot
mapper.update: UPDATE evaluation_run SET lease_expires_at = clock_timestamp() + (#{leaseMs} * interval '1 millisecond'), updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{runId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_owner = #{owner} AND lease_expires_at > clock_timestamp()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO evaluation_result(run_id, case_id, result_snapshot) SELECT id, #{caseId}, CAST(#{snapshot} AS jsonb) FROM evaluation_run WHERE id = #{runId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_owner = #{owner} AND lease_expires_at > clock_timestamp() ON CONFLICT (run_id, case_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE evaluation_run SET status = #{status}, summary = CAST(#{summary} AS jsonb), error_code = #{error}, finished_at = clock_timestamp(), updated_at = clock_timestamp(), lease_owner = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_owner = #{owner} AND lease_expires_at > clock_timestamp()
mapper.select: SELECT id, dataset_id, name, mode, status, error_code, config_snapshot::text AS config_snapshot, summary::text AS summary, started_at, finished_at FROM evaluation_run WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT case_id, result_snapshot::text AS snapshot FROM evaluation_result WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY case_id
mapper.sql: FROM document_chunk c JOIN document d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE c.id = #{chunkId} AND c.chunk_type = 'CHILD' AND NOT c.deleted AND NOT d.deleted AND c.document_version = d.current_version AND d.status = 'COMPLETED'
mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.current_version, d.sha256, c.id AS chunk_id, c.chunk_type, c.chunk_index, c.embedding_model, c.embedding_dimensions, c.embedding_content_hash FROM document d JOIN document_chunk c ON c.document_id = d.id WHERE d.knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} AND NOT d.deleted AND NOT c.deleted AND c.document_version = d.current_version ORDER BY d.id, c.id
